approval_evidence.quote: 08/17/2011 ORIG-1 Approval (Drugs@FDA, Original Approvals or Tentative Approvals)

series_start_reason: Roche's nine-month 2011 release (13 Oct 2011) prints the first Zelboraf sales (nine months 11, all United States); the half-year 2011 release (21 Jul 2011) has no Zelboraf sales row (the product appears only in regulatory text), and FDA approval was 17 Aug 2011, so the nine-month figure is read as 2011Q3. This is an inference from the absence of an earlier row.
series_end_reason: The Roche Q1 2017 investor update (https://assets.roche.com/f/176343/9c1645bdf0/inv-update-2017-04-27.pdf) and every later results release read prints no Zelboraf sales row; the last row is the FY2016 release (inv-update-2017-02-01-e.pdf), where Zelboraf shows 213. Not checked: Roche Finance Reports / Annual Reports.
notes: Printed line is 'Zelboraf'; worldwide Total column. Quarterly Top 20 table lists it only in the releases from Q1 2013 to FY2014 (the table's columns cover 2012Q1 to 2014Q4); all other quarters are read from Q1 year-to-date tables or year-to-date differences. launch_quarter left null because no Roche document read states a launch quarter (FDA approval 17 Aug 2011).
search_log: reused the earlier Roche crawl (roche.com/investors/events/{q1,hy,q3,annual-results}-YYYY, 2016-2026) and its downloaded Investor update PDFs, plus the assets.cwp.roche.com/imported/en/med-cor-YYYY-MM-DD-e.pdf results releases for 2011-2015 found by dated probing; 63 results releases from the FY2010 release (2011-02-02) to the half-year 2026 release (2026-07-23) were read as text

per release read two tables: the worldwide 'Top 20 Pharmaceuticals Division quarterly product sales' table (five quarter columns, Total table that precedes the United States/Europe/Japan/International tables) and the year-to-date product sales table (Total, United States, Europe, Japan, International); quarters taken from the own release quarter column when printed, else the Q1 year-to-date table (three months), else the earliest later release that prints the quarter, else year-to-date differences

wherever both a printed quarter and a year-to-date difference existed they were compared: no difference found; for every calendar year whose four quarters are in the series the sum equals the full-year (January-December) figure of that year's FY release
Roche half-year/annual reports and Finance Reports, and the 2009-2010 quarterly results releases, were not retrieved or used for rows; Chugai/Genentech documents were not used
Zelboraf absence before 2011Q3: med-cor-2011-07-21-e.pdf (half-year 2011) mentions Zelboraf only in regulatory/pipeline text and prints no sales row

end of series: no Zelboraf sales row in f_inv-update-2017-04-27 (Q1 2017) or f_inv-update-2017-07-27-e (half-year 2017) - the Q1 2017 'Top-selling pharmaceuticals and recent new launches' table lists Gazyva and Cotellic but no Zelboraf; no later results release (38 read) prints a Zelboraf sales row (text mentions only)
